text:
Maria Chen: FYI customer MedHealth (private VPC) — calls are being routed to eu-central1 not us-west, causing high latency and occasional 401s. Ticket 4567: https://support.redwood.ai/t/4567
Jon Patel: can you paste a raw curl + response headers? also which private deployment (vpc-id)?
Maria Chen: vpc-0a1b2c3d in us-west-2. curl that shows the server region header:
Maria Chen: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"```
Maria Chen: response headers: \nHTTP/1.1 200 OK\nX-Serving-Region: eu-central1\nX-Request-Id: r-9f8a\n\n(body omitted)
Kevin O'Neill: do an `ip route get` from their egress gateway and also tcpdump for source IP. suspect partner transit picking EU path
Jon Patel: traceroute shows next-hop into our peering partner colo in eu-west then to eu-central1 cluster, i can paste
Jon Patel: ```traceroute to api.redwood.ai (34.210.10.5), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1 (10.0.0.1)  0.5 ms  0.4 ms  0.3 ms
 4  198.51.100.2 (198.51.100.2)  35.2 ms  36.1 ms  35.7 ms
 6  * * *
 8  eu-colo-gw.example.net (203.0.113.5)  180.2 ms  179.5 ms  179.8 ms
 10  api-eu-01.internal (34.210.10.5)  180.7 ms
```
Samir Gupta: pattern fits: their SD-WAN/partner transit HAS a more-specific prefix or higher local-preference that pushes traffic to our EU peering, despite source being us-west. If SNAT'd by their gateway we see our routing choose EU cluster by prefix origin or AS path length.
Maria Chen: they reported a config change yesterday to the transit provider (policy-based route) — possible they introduced a community or prepend that changes BGP pref
Kevin O'Neill: quick checks for the customer: 1) on egress gateway run `ip route get 34.210.10.5 from <their-src-ip>` 2) `tcpdump -nni eth0 host 34.210.10.5` capture first 10 packets 3) paste X-Forwarded-For / Via headers from our logs
Maria Chen: performed `ip route get` -> returned next-hop 198.51.100.2 (partner) which then goes to eu-colo-gw. I uploaded tcpdump snippet to ticket.
DeployBot: healthcheck alert: cluster-usw-01 trailing by 1.2s for incoming connection from 198.51.100.2 at 2025-09-22T14:12:10Z
Jon Patel: root cause hypothesis: partner transit started advertising a more-specific or we accepted a prepended route; AWS VGW / Transit gateway side might be honoring that partner's AS path next-hop
Samir Gupta: mitigation options: 1) ask partner to stop advertising the more-specific / change community 2) add src-based policy route on customer's egress to prefer direct internet path to our us-west public IPs 3) we can add explicit peering deny for that partner but that's heavy
Olivia (CS): customer is anxious about billing — they saw requests billed under EU model. Does that affect their entitlements? Should we credit the extra cost for the window?
Maria Chen: billing note: billing records are tied to region that answered the request. we should flag this to Billing ops; propose credit for the +latency days and rotate any short-lived tokens if they suspect replay or token-scoped region mismatch
Kevin O'Neill: for long-term fix we shipped a routing preference change last month — but not applied to partner peering. I'll open infra-ops ticket to add a region affinity ACL for known partner ASNs; that'll require change window
Jon Patel: repro steps for support engineers:
Jon Patel: 1) from customer egress GW: `curl -sv -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health --dump-header -`
Jon Patel: 2) `ip route get <api-ip> from <src-ip>`
Jon Patel: 3) `tcpdump -nni <if> host <api-ip> and port 443` capture first SYN/ACK
Jon Patel: 4) send capture to eng-netops + include AS path from partner BGP table (`show ip bgp <prefix>`)
Samir Gupta: added quick patch: temporary route-map on our edge to prefer us-west origin for src prefixes matching vpc-0a1b2c3d. Deployed to canary edge, monitoring.
Maria Chen: confirmed canary now returns X-Serving-Region: us-west-2 for test requests. latency back to ~50ms. I'll ask customer to re-run tests.
Olivia (CS): customer accepted the workaround and asked for ETA on full fix. What's timeline?
Kevin O'Neill: infra-ops wants to roll region-affinity ACL and update partner config — planning for Tuesday maintenance (48h) pending partner ack
Maria Chen: tagging ticket with notes and next steps. recommend CS offer credit and temporary token rotation if they saw auth errors. closing the Slack thread, will update when maintenance is scheduled :thumbsup:
